findings.detail: The parser assigned the Par / Units foreign currency marker to cost_currency for the Armstrong GBP term loan; amortized cost is in the USD-denominated cost column.
The parser assigned the Par / Units foreign currency marker to cost_currency for the Armstrong GBP delayed draw term loan; amortized cost is in the USD-denominated cost column.
The parser assigned the Par / Units foreign currency marker to cost_currency for the Bamboo EUR term loan; amortized cost is in the USD-denominated cost column.
The parser assigned the Par / Units foreign currency marker to cost_currency for the Sensor Technology EUR term loan; amortized cost is in the USD-denominated cost column.
The parser assigned the Par / Units foreign currency marker to cost_currency for the Sitecore EUR term loan; amortized cost is in the USD-denominated cost column.

rationale: FX03 is a real extraction error. The source schedule uses foreign currency markers for Par / Units on GBP/EUR loans, but the flagged field is cost_currency. The cited rows show the foreign marker before par amount, then separate amortized cost and fair value values in the schedule's investment value columns. Therefore the stored cost_currency values GBP/EUR are column bleed from Par / Units, not the currency of cost.
